product_metadata.title: AmazerBath Grey and White Shower Curtain, 72" W x 72" H Grey Shower Curtain Stripes, Fabric Shower Curtain for Bathroom with 2 Heavy Duty Stones
features: Premium polyester fabric shower curtain: The fabric shower curtain stripes is made of PVC-free polyester fabric, soft and comfortable to touch. It's water-repellent, you can use it alone as a 2-in-1 shower curtain and liner.
2 heavy duty clear stones - There are 2 heavy duty clear stones on bottom corners to get more weight and reduce the striped shower curtain from blowing.
Reinforced metal holes - The durable shower curtain with 12 durable metal grommets fits most curtain hooks.
Easy cleaning - The decorative shower curtain is machine washable and dries quickly. Strong fabric and tight sewn hem avoid shrinkage and deformation. Please do not bleach the shower curtain.
Classic design - The fabric gray and white shower curtain with stripes classic pattern brings you a lovely home and a releasing bath.
